formula: 2 * num_hidden_layers * num_key_value_heads * head_dim * dtype_bytes * batch_size * sequence_length
notes: K and V are both included; batch size multiplies every value.
This excludes cache metadata, allocation padding, temporary attention buffers, activations, engine memory and all non-KV runtime memory.
FP16 and BF16 both use two bytes per cache element.
